title: mail-types: emailpush feature (URI, capabilities, EmailPushConfig normalized serde, EmailPush, accessors)
description:
Design: docs/design/emailpush.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: E2. Crates: jmap-mail-types. Size: S.

Spec: draft-ietf-jmap-emailpush-05 §2.1, §3, §4, §5 figures, §7. Design: docs/design/emailpush.md §4, §3 (decision 3), and decision 9 in docs/design/DECISIONS.md.

Add feature `emailpush` to crate-jmap-mail-types (no new deps, no async). Private mod emailpush, items re-exported at the crate root as in the mdn/sieve layout of lib.rs: JMAP_EMAILPUSH_URI, EMAIL_PUSH_PROPERTY, EmailPushCapability and EmailPushAccountCapability (empty + extra), EmailPushConfig { filter: Option<EmailFilter> (serde default, ALWAYS serialized, null included), properties: Vec<String> (default []), urgency: jmap_types::Urgency (default "normal"), extra }, EmailPush (hand-written serde like jmap_types::StateChange: @type "EmailPush" always emitted, another value rejected without echoing it, absence accepted; accountId, emails: Vec<Map>, state: Option<State> always serialized, extra), accessors email_push(&PushSubscription) and set_email_push(&mut PushSubscription, Option<BTreeMap<Id, EmailPushConfig>>). All #[non_exhaustive]. The serde defaults are the single source of the normalized form (decision 9).
Acceptance (hand-written JSON oracles from the spec): the §5 Session capability figure deserializes and `"urn:ietf:params:jmap:emailpush": {}` round-trips; the §5 EmailPush figure round-trips equal as a Value with "state": null emitted; a wrong @type is rejected and a missing one accepted; vendor extras on EmailPush and EmailPushConfig are preserved; `{}` decodes and re-serializes to exactly {"filter":null,"properties":[],"urgency":"normal"}; "urgent" fails to decode. Public-api snapshot refreshed.
